notes: Rendered two-column MECHANICAL AND PLUMBING DRAWINGS LEGEND reviewed row by row: 96 drawn rows total, of which 92 have usable vector evidence (57 physical-symbol identities, 26 routed-system line styles, and 9 drafting annotations). The SWITCH row's identifying S and the EXISTING/FUTURE/NEW rows' (E)/(F)/(N) markers are PDF text rather than vector glyphs and are intentionally excluded from vector-glyph truth. A second full-resolution Poppler review confirmed that MOTORIZED DAMPER owns its boxed M carrier plus dashed damper line, while FLOOR/WALL/GRADE CLEANOUT each own the full hooked leader and physical device geometry surrounding their internal ECO/WCO/GCO PDF text. These four complete physical identities may therefore proceed to mandatory real-plan anchor corroboration. PIPE ANCHOR is a complete inline device spanning its pipe stub.
